name: Benefit Crystallisation Event 2
definition: Information about the realisation of benefits taken from a pension.

EventTypeNumber.name: Event Type Number
EventTypeNumber.definition: Number of the crystallisation event. In the UK market this could be, for example, BCE5, BE5A or BCE5B.

EventTypeName.name: Event Type Name
EventTypeName.definition: Name of the crystallisation event. In the UK market this could be, for example, ‘entitlement to scheme pension’.

EventDate.name: Event Date
EventDate.definition: Date on which the crystallisation event was triggered.

PercentageOfAllowance.name: Percentage Of Allowance
PercentageOfAllowance.definition: Percentage of allowance used for the benefit crystallisation event.

LifetimeAllowanceProtection.name: Lifetime Allowance Protection
LifetimeAllowanceProtection.definition: Indicates whether lifetime allowance protection impacts the benefit crystallisation event.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the benefit crystallisation event.
